# R02 retained pre-S-4 Population campaigns

These are byte-for-byte copies of the three lawful packages retained by the original R02 source investigation, before A01 implementation, on the accepted pre-S-4 engine baseline `49c2892344104ed530b87abf38ee1afee82d4c35`. The original diagnostic and its golden canonical digests are already recorded in the architectural audit's first R02 report. No package was re-generated by the reconciliation candidate, no old binding was re-cited, and no ledger was backfilled.

Only the operative package files are copied (manifest, checkpoint state and journal); migration backup files are not required for open and are not copied. The directory `history/` is recreated empty on the private test copy. Tests never open the checked-in witness in place.

The ordinary and PCB-01 packages end after their lawful transaction; the interrupted package ends after the genuine Population stage before the final clock commit. They retain the ORIGINAL headless binding and pre-A01/S-4 checkpoint policy. The current combined verifier must accept their real incremental histories, reproduce every original receipt and golden state/journal digest, and lawfully resume the interrupted case.

New campaigns seeded after PR #107 contain an additional source-qualified ledger group and a new binding citation. Their different canonical digests are separately measured on pristine merged main `bdc46e7c930ba88951c56a003ce3ddb4ef0d9067`; those new digests must not replace these old records.
